title: Void-First Formation of Cosmic Filaments and Attractors: An Experimental DRND Test with SDSS, 2M++, and Peculiar-Velocity Data
description: Version v.1.0.0 of the GitHub-ready repository package void-first-formation-of-cosmic-filaments-and-attractors. Reproducible technical-preprint package testing a DRND-motivated void-first formation concept for cosmic filaments and attractors against SDSS void lensing, SDSS DR8 filament axes, Carrick/2M++ reconstructed velocity fields, SDSS PV, Cosmicflows-4 and SDSS/eBOSS RSD context. The package treats filaments as secondary compression ridges and attractors as convergence nodes of void-shell fronts. It explicitly separates prior void-growth, Dipole-Repeller and topological-skeleton phenomenology from the narrower proposed DRND mechanism: phase-degraded relational domains, MFPT-like transport bottlenecks and locked topological shell gain. It also separates JWST high-redshift local protostructures from mature void-bounded cosmic-web filaments, defining the falsification boundary as the early appearance of a global SDSS-like void-and-filament foam. It reports a robust void-shell radial filament-orientation anomaly and a conditional Carrick void-in-void monopole outflow, while preserving negative line-of-sight PV controls and explicit Lambda-CDM mock-comparison requirements.
